name: feat-2893-3d
title: #2893 phase 4 — 3-D: a search that runs out says «עדיין לא נמצא פתרון» and offers to keep searching (PR, port 5188)

cases.title: 3-D: a range no drawing reaches — the tool says it has not found one yet, and «המשיכו לחפש» searches again
cases.lookFor: Type the two lines. After the second, «חושב…» for about 10 seconds, then under the box: «עדיין לא נמצא פתרון — החיפוש נעצר אחרי כ-10 שניות.» with a button «המשיכו לחפש». The line stays in the box and is not added (one row). Press «המשיכו לחפש»: about 10 seconds more, and the same sentence again. Then type something else in the box: the sentence goes away.
cases.before: On prod the line is refused at once: «אין תצורה של הציור שבה הזווית נמצאת בתחום הזה, ולכן הנתון לא נוסף. בדקו את גבולות התחום.»

cases.title: 3-D: a range on a figure the solver places — the sentence comes after about 10 seconds, not after minutes
cases.lookFor: Three rows; the fourth line stays in the box and the sentence with «המשיכו לחפש» shows about 10 seconds after Enter.
cases.before: On prod the page freezes for nearly two minutes (measured 114 s), then refuses the line.

cases.title: 3-D: a range a drawing does reach is added at once, with no question
cases.lookFor: Two rows, the pyramid drawn; no sentence.

cases.title: 3-D: a wrong claim is still refused, word for word
cases.lookFor: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב»; one row; no «המשיכו לחפש».

cases.title: 3-D: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» on a figure with a range still redraws, with no question
cases.lookFor: Each press draws another pyramid; no sentence.

cases.title: 3-D: an ordinary figure and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» are untouched
cases.lookFor: The cube and M on BB′; the press redraws.
